311_service_requests: Entity: 311 service requests; Grain: one row per service request (unique_key); Notable keys/measures: unique_key, complaint_description, source, status, status_change_date, created_date, last_update_date, close_date, incident_address, street_number, street_name, city, incident_zip, council_district_code, map_page, map_tile, latitude, longitude, state_plane_x_coordinate, state_plane_y_coordinate, location.
bikeshare_stations: Entity: bikeshare stations/assets; Grain: one row per station (station_id); Notable keys/measures: station_id, name, alternate_name, status, address, city_asset_number, property_type, number_of_docks, power_type, footprint_length, footprint_width, notes, council_district, modified_date, address.
bikeshare_trips: Entity: individual bikeshare trips; Grain: one row per trip (trip_id); Notable keys/measures: trip_id, subscriber_type, bike_id, bike_type, start_time, start_station_id, start_station_name, end_station_id, end_station_name, duration_minutes.
crime: Entity: recorded crimes/incidents; Grain: one row per crime record (unique_key); Notable keys/measures: unique_key, primary_type, description, location_description, address, zipcode, census_tract, district, council_district_code, timestamp, year, clearance_status, clearance_date, x_coordinate, y_coordinate, latitude, longitude, location.
incidents_<N>: Entity: incidents (generic table variant); Grain: one row per incident (unique_key); Notable keys/measures: unique_key, descript, date, time, address, timestamp, longitude, latitude, location.
waste_and_diversion: Entity: waste/diversion truck loads or dropoffs; Grain: one row per load/report (load_id); Notable keys/measures: load_id, report_date, load_type, load_time, load_weight, dropoff_site, route_type, route_number.
